Governing law for this Agreement shall be the United Kingdom’s Medicines Act 1968 and related regulations. All disputes, including those concerning professional negligence, shall be referred to the NHS Mediation Service, and if unresolved, shall be finally determined by the courts of England and Wales, with the exclusive venue being the Royal Courts of Justice in London.

The Parties may mutually agree to terminate this Agreement at any time by executing a written Termination Agreement. Such mutual termination shall be conditioned upon the settlement of all outstanding invoices, the return or secure destruction of confidential information, and the execution of a final reconciliation statement. Upon satisfaction of these conditions, each Party releases the other from any further obligations under this Agreement.

{"clause_type": "termination", "risk_level": "low", "key_obligations": ["settle invoices", "handle confidential info", "execute reconciliation"], "summary": "Describes a mutual termination process requiring settlement of invoices and handling of confidential data."}

Extract metadata from this clause:

In the event that any applicable financial regulator issues an order that materially impairs the ability of either Party to perform its obligations, either Party may terminate this Agreement upon written notice. The terminating Party shall cooperate to ensure an orderly wind‑down of Services, including the secure transfer of client data to the Client within thirty (30) days. All fees earned up to the termination date shall be payable, and any prepaid fees shall be refunded on a pro‑rata basis.

{"clause_type": "termination", "risk_level": "medium", "key_obligations": ["notify termination", "wind‑down services", "settle fees"], "summary": "Allows termination due to regulatory changes, requiring cooperation for data transfer and fee settlement."}

The Supplier may engage Subcontractors to perform any portion of the Services, provided that each Subcontractor is pre‑approved in writing by the Manufacturer. The Supplier shall remain fully responsible for the performance of its Subcontractors and shall ensure that all Subcontractors comply with the terms of this Agreement, including but not limited to quality standards, delivery schedules, and safety regulations.

{"clause_type": "subcontracting", "risk_level": "medium", "key_obligations": ["obtain approval", "maintain responsibility", "ensure compliance"], "summary": "Supplier can use approved Subcontractors but stays liable for their performance and compliance."}
